scope.basis: Course-bound proposed asset groups, not individual finished image designs; one group may require several distinct images.
scope.completeness: Topic-level inventory based on the earlier handbook review and manual selection from current accepted card exports. Related lesson and quiz matches are fact-ID joins. Not a full handbook image extraction, not a complete per-card audit, and no claim of factual clearance.
scope.current_observation: The static Utah preview presents text lessons, cards, and quizzes; the store sign map inspected maps Idaho only and does not map Utah. Code/data inspection; not a live browser test.

sources.page_number_note: pdf_page is the physical PDF page number copied from the source card; printed_page is the source card value.

asset_policy.signs: Use accurate, appropriately sourced sign artwork; verify current authoritative specification, local applicability, provenance and reuse rights. Do not invent signs.
asset_policy.diagrams: Create clear diagrams only after the scenario and visual details are checked against official Utah evidence; do not infer unstated rules.
asset_policy.handbook_art: The run config says handbook artwork is not cleared for reproduction. Check rights before reusing it.
asset_policy.accessibility: Supply meaningful alternative text; do not rely on color alone.
asset_policy.cross_state: Reuse only after verifying each state rule, wording, scenario and applicability; never assume a shared diagram is accurate in all states.
